title: Split drive-rest.ts, so Drive's final version check sits outside the step marked uncertain
evidence: packages/health-core/src/drive-rest.ts is 730 lines, over the 500 cap, so S57 did not change it. driveUpdateIfVersion runs its last version check inside the step Google Drive's adapter marks uncertain: a 4xx on that check, before any upload, keeps an erase the cloud never took in memory, as today (S57's Codex R2). Split the file first (a byte-pure move), then move the check out of the uncertain-wrapped step so a refusal there counts as a definite refusal (write-refusal.ts).
